lupin.description: The registered Lupin parameters as capsules run them. Motion is estimated in preprocessing but not applied.

lupin-motion-applied.description: Applies the estimated motion to the preprocessed recording, so interpolation and the motion-corrected postprocessing run too.

lupin-no-motion.description: Neither estimates nor corrects motion anywhere, as the registered `no-motion` key intends for older releases.

lupin-all-channels.description: Keeps every channel, as the registered `all-channels` key intends for older releases. Bad and out-of-brain channels are detected but never removed.
